thread:
Eli: Noticing a cluster-wide spike in bootstrap failures — lots of 403s when nodes try to read keystore secrets. e.g., node-ml-23.
Sam: same here, started ~03:10 UTC after the proxy rewrite.
Juno: sample from node-init: 
```
2026-07-12T03:11:02Z init: vault read failed status=403 path=secret/data/prod/keystore/node-token
error="permission denied" policy="proxy-translate-2026-07-12"
```
Rina (security): We rolled a proxy that rewrites legacy paths to the new regional paths (infra/keystore/%region%/*). Looks like the translation table missed the artifact-service principal and some older boot agents still request the legacy path verbatim.
Eli: consequence: nodes can't unwrap keys -> kube join fails -> autoscaler keeps launching replacement nodes -> elevated on-demand GPU spend in useast-2. ops-bot pinged cost.
ops-bot: Cost alert: us-east-2 GPU spend +88% vs baseline (03:30).
Sam: Quick mitigation idea: add a temporary policy that allows the legacy path for the agent SA for 45m, inject a fallback token into the bootstrap secret. low blast radius.
Rina (security): I can approve an emergency exception if we scope it to agent SA and TTL 45m. we also need to re-enable audit-exporter; the proxy deploy paused it to avoid duplicate events.
Juno: commands (dry-run then apply):
```
vault policy write temp-legacy-agent - <<EOF
path "secret/data/prod/keystore/node-token" {
  capabilities = ["read"]
}
EOF
vault token create -policy=temp-legacy-agent -orphan -ttl=45m
kubectl -n infra create secret generic fallback-bootstrap-token --from-literal=token=<token> --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
```
Eli: doing the apply now. will annotate exception in the runbook.
Sam: re-enabled audit-exporter, restarted deployment.
ops-bot: Audit exporter: toggled -> enabled.
Juno: nodes are starting to fetch keystore tokens and join warm pool. prewarm ~60% after 22min. cost alert downgraded at 03:55.
Asha (compliance): Please capture affected node IDs, timeline, policy diff, and the exception request. we'll need that in the compliance report.
Rina (security): follow-ups: (1) add artifact-service smoke-check to proxy translation rollout, (2) add an automated policy-diff check that compares pre/post allowlists, (3) make audit toggles require two-person approval. I'll own the PRs.
Eli: opening PLT ticket PLT-8246 with owners and steps. closing once warm pool stable.
ops-bot: Incident logged: INC-2026-0712-PROXY-TRANSLATE. linked: PLT-8246, COMPL-611.
